title: Figma: Demo · Site is paused at the tool limit

owner_note.text: The Figma MCP call limit stopped the demo build. The page Demo · Site exists with ten blank 1920×1080 scrolling screens; the build script for the dark-sidebar screens is saved and ready. Resume after the limit resets: kit/demo.md lists exactly what is left.
